OpenMap
nodes.rationale: Sovereign open-source replacement for Device42: discovery, dependency mapping, CMDB, IPAM/DNS/DHCP, DCIM, software/licence, vulnerability correlation, BSM, time travel, embedded Superset, AI assistant. One release, no phases.

nodes.label: No hardcoding rule
nodes.rationale: Every host, port, URL, path, credential, threshold, colour, label, model name comes from packages/config (zod-validated env), tenant settings in the DB, or packages/constants. A literal that could differ between deployments is a bug.

nodes.label: Fully functional, no dummy sections
nodes.rationale: No TODO/placeholder/mock in apps/ or packages/; every screen, endpoint, collector, job and report works end to end against the real compose stack.

nodes.label: Sovereign by default
nodes.rationale: No outbound network call at runtime except collectors to their targets and tenant-enabled integrations; the air-gapped compose profile must pass the full e2e suite.

nodes.label: Open source only, no product dependency
nodes.rationale: GPL/AGPL components run as separate processes, never linked; IPAM, DCIM and BSM are built in rather than delegated to NetBox, Grafana or an ITSM.
nodes.norm_label: open source only, no product dependency

nodes.label: Arabic/RTL and English from first commit
nodes.rationale: No user-facing string in code; every string is an i18n key with both locales filled so RTL is never retrofitted.
nodes.norm_label: arabic/rtl and english from first commit

nodes.label: Project memory files
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md, STATE.md, the tracker, GRAPH_REPORT.md, SPEC.md, ADRs and CONTRACTS.md are read at session start and written at session end so context is never lost; if STATE.md and tracker disagree the tracker wins.

nodes.label: OpenMap-Tracker.xlsx
nodes.rationale: Only edited through tools/tracker (ExcelJS CLI, pnpm tracker); no requirement exists unless it is a row; pnpm tracker verify blocks merges when a Done row lacks tests and evidence.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: Structural memory of the codebase; docs/ is inside the graph so SPEC, ADRs and STATE link requirements to the code that implements them; REQ ids in commit messages and file headers form the links.

nodes.label: Definition of Done
nodes.rationale: Merged on main, unit+integration+e2e+k6 tests with IDs in the tracker, guard passes, en+ar keys with RTL screenshot, contracts bumped via ADR, OTel spans and Prometheus metric, works in airgap profile, STATE and graph refreshed.

nodes.label: pnpm guard (tools/guard)
nodes.rationale: Fails the build on forbidden tokens, any-casts, literal IPs/URLs/ports outside config, magic numbers in apps/, user-facing string literals in the console, files without a REQ header, and Done rows without evidence.

nodes.label: Contracts first
nodes.rationale: REQ-CORE-001…010 freeze packages/contracts before any other workstream starts, so parallel subagents per workstream can build against a stable CI schema, collector schema, GraphQL schema and event schema.

nodes.label: tools/synth-estate
nodes.rationale: Deterministic 100k-CI estate generator replayed through the real collector contract; a generator exercising the real pipeline, explicitly not a mock.

nodes.label: Performance targets
nodes.rationale: p95 under 100 ms per screen interaction, under 1 s for a 100k-node impact query, 60 fps graph rendering, 10k devices discovered in under 15 minutes; performance is a tracked requirement, not a tuning pass.

nodes.label: docs/SPEC.md
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for scope and architecture; wins over CLAUDE.md on disagreement.

nodes.label: Coding standards
nodes.rationale: TS strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess; Go 1.23 with slog; NestJS one module per bounded context with outbox for every cross-store write; Next.js server components by default, TanStack Virtual lists, Sigma.js in a Web Worker; design tokens only.

nodes.label: @openmap/console
nodes.rationale: Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, Tailwind v4, TanStack Query and Virtual on the Obsidian Pro design system; reads CONSOLE_PORT via loadEnv() in scripts/next.ts and derives NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL from PUBLIC_API_URL at build time so nothing in the package names a port or URL.

nodes.label: Locale routing ([locale] segment)
nodes.rationale: Routes under src/app/[locale]/ validated with isLocale; layout sets html lang/dir and mounts Providers; / redirects to /<DEFAULT_LOCALE>/dashboard read at request time; middleware prefixes paths lacking a locale; switcher swaps the first segment so the same screen reopens in the other language.

nodes.rationale: next build regenerates next-env.d.ts without a requirement header; the postbuild script prepends one so pnpm guard stays green.

nodes.rationale: dashboard shows KPIs and service health from layers/services queries; layers shows twelve layers with per-device visibility in localStorage and an isometric stack; cmdb is a virtualised CI list over the cursor-paginated cis query with layer filter chips, ?q= becoming the contract's text filter.

nodes.rationale: Every CI node carries :Ci and a PascalCase type label from CI_TYPES; every RELATIONSHIP_TYPES member is an upper-case edge type with direction exactly as the contract names it. Node properties mirror the Postgres cis row; attributes stay in Postgres/ClickHouse because the graph answers structure questions only.

nodes.label: Retired CIs removed from graph
nodes.rationale: Retired CIs and relationships are deleted from Memgraph (Postgres and ClickHouse keep them) so a traversal never filters on validTo; time-travel structure questions go to ci_history/relationship_history in ClickHouse.

nodes.label: Memgraph constraints and indexes
nodes.rationale: Unique c.id, existence of tenantId and type, property indexes incl. composite (tenantId, type, identityKey) for reconciliation lookups, a label index per CI type and edge-type index per relationship type so named-edge traversals never scan, :BusinessService(impactedBy) for blast-radius ranking.

nodes.label: Impact query shape
nodes.rationale: Edges point from dependant to dependency so impact flows against the arrows: MATCH (c:Ci)<-[:DEPENDS_ON|RUNS_ON|POWERED_BY|HOSTED_ON*1..$depth]-(x)-[:PART_OF_SERVICE]->(s:BusinessService); power and rack scenarios expand the failed set first via LOCATED_IN then reuse the shape with WHERE c.id IN $ids; $depth from ImpactScenario.options.maxDepth.

nodes.label: BusinessService.impactedBy triggers
nodes.rationale: Three AFTER COMMIT triggers (edge create, edge delete, service create) maintain the count of distinct CIs whose failure reaches a service within {impact_closure_depth} hops, so the console shows blast radius per row without a traversal per row.

nodes.label: IMPACT_CLOSURE_DEPTH parameter
nodes.rationale: Substituted by the runner from src/parameters.ts because a Cypher variable-length range bound must be a literal.

nodes.label: Twelve-layer estate model
nodes.rationale: One model of the estate so every screen, query and answer agrees on what a thing is and what depends on it.

nodes.label: Sovereign by default (no outbound calls, air-gapped profile)
nodes.rationale: Open-source components only, no runtime call except collectors to their targets, full test suite passes in an air-gapped profile.
nodes.norm_label: sovereign by default (no outbound calls, air-gapped profile)

nodes.label: Contracts first
nodes.rationale: CI, collector, GraphQL and event schemas are versioned; changing one requires an ADR and a CI check so workstreams can run in parallel against stable shapes.

nodes.label: Synthetic estate generator (tools/synth-estate)
nodes.rationale: A deterministic 100k-CI estate replayed through the real collector contract: a generator exercising the real pipeline, not a mock.

nodes.label: ADR-028 Ask becomes a conversation
nodes.rationale: Syed's 2026-11-05 review: Ask was one question to one Cypher statement over Memgraph only, with no server-side conversation state and a 1.5B model copying prompt fragments; measurements in ClickHouse and attributes in Postgres were out of reach.

nodes.label: Syed review 2026-11-05: Ask chat is dumb
nodes.norm_label: syed review 2026-11-05: ask chat is dumb

nodes.label: A conversation is a record
nodes.rationale: Persisting turns per user lets a follow-up resolve against the previous turn's entities and period; one row per exchange holds question and answer, so the column is outcome (answered, clarified, failed) rather than role.

nodes.label: Five levels: understand, plan, retrieve, compose, follow up
nodes.rationale: Deterministic where it matters: the classifier, the planner and the follow-ups are deterministic; the LLM is only a low-confidence fallback and a prose rewriter under a guard.
nodes.norm_label: five levels: understand, plan, retrieve, compose, follow up

nodes.label: Bilingual intent classifier with clarifications
nodes.rationale: An ambiguous CMDB match becomes a clarifying question, not a guess; the LLM fills gaps below a confidence floor but never overrides.

nodes.label: Grounding guard on model prose
nodes.rationale: Every number in the prose must occur in the results and every CI named must be in the evidence, otherwise the sentence is replaced by the deterministic summary; needed because the CPU-profile model copies prompt fragments verbatim.

nodes.label: Deterministic follow-up resolution
nodes.rationale: A continuation opener or a short fragment inherits what it left out from the previous turn's persisted reading; the intent is re-derived from merged entities; a new subject type drops names and scope and carries a measurement to its equivalent metric.

nodes.label: Calendar period on a measurement read as a rolling window
nodes.rationale: Measurements are sampled, not booked to calendar months as availability is, so 'CPU last month' becomes a window of ASSISTANT.rollingDays.
nodes.norm_label: calendar period on a measurement read as a rolling window

nodes.label: Evaluation set in CI (trained for OpenMap)
nodes.rationale: Trained for OpenMap means a catalogue generated from the contracts, worked examples per skill and a checked-in question set with an accuracy floor, not model weights; failures are events so the catalogue grows from real questions.
nodes.norm_label: evaluation set in ci (trained for openmap)

nodes.label: LoRA fine-tuning on the evaluation set (documented next step)
nodes.rationale: Qwen2.5-7B on the GPU profile once a GPU host exists; the first increment does not depend on it.
nodes.norm_label: lora fine-tuning on the evaluation set (documented next step)

nodes.label: Skill cmdb.attributes (Postgres aggregates)
nodes.rationale: The two reported failures become skill cases: 'OS per server' groups hosts by os, 'VMs per host in VMware' aggregates over runs_on with the average in SQL, never in nested Cypher.
